description:
Position : PennDOT - Legacy TS5 
 
 Location : Harrisburg, PA 
 
 Duration : 5 Months 
 
 
 Short Description: 
 Serve as a senior level resource in design and development of backend systems for mobile applications. Primary duties will revolve around Java web services, database work, and WMB. 
 
 Complete Description: 
 ***This requisition requires onsite in-person first round interviews only.*** 
 ***Client would prefer candidates local to the Harrisburg, PA Area.*** 
 
 
 Serve as a senior level resource in design and development of backend systems for mobile applications. Primary duties will revolve around Java web services, database work, and WMB. 
 
 Role Description 
 • Lead in design and development of backend systems for Mobile Applications. 
 • Demonstrate expertise in wide range of backend systems and protocols, including WMB and IIB service development. 
 • Propose comprehensive solutions based on business and technical requirements. 
 • Create ball park estimates. 
 • Participate in architecting, designing and developing user interface, service tier and data tier components for enterprise Mobile Applications. 
 • Develop and document standards, architecture, repeatable processes, and reusable components. 
 • Participate in project planning, including development of timelines, propose composition of technical teams, and leveling of resources. 
 • Mentor team members on Department processes and standards to promote consistency and improve productivity. 
 • Design and create database schemas in DB2 and Oracle RDBMSs. 
 • Perform server side code reviews to ensure best practices. 
 • Participate in the full SDLC process (including coding) of Mobile Application solutions using Java, Javascript, HTML5, CSS3, JSON, XML, JDBC, SQL, web services, WMB, and IIB. 
 • Attend meetings, including daily standup meetings, on a daily basis. 
 • Support product deployment and product validations on or off business hours. 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
